description:
When you send your money out into the world, bless it. [Tell me in the comments below if you commit to this].

When you buy a book from a bookstore, bless the bookseller, and when you enjoy a cup of coffee, glorify the barista. You get my drift.

Just become an unlimited, highly enthusiastic gratefulness spreader. To uplift lives. And to increase your wealth. As the timeless truth teaches us, the hand that gives, gathers.

My latest book “The Wealth Money Can’t Buy” is full of fresh ideas and original tools that I’m absolutely certain will cause quantum leaps in your positivity, productivity,wellness, and happiness

Get your copy now at:
TheWealthMoneyCantBuy.com or send me a DM with the words “Real Wealth” [NOT in the comments but a DM please].

My very best wishes,
Robin
transcript: want to read you a chapter of my new book, The Wealth Money Can't Buy, that you are going to find very strange. Yes, strange. And it's called Bless Your Money. The book is based on eight forms of wealth. Money is one of the forms of wealth. In the section on money, there's 20 plus chapters on what I've learned from the billionaires in terms of how they build their great fortunes. But there's one chapter that I wanted to read to you, which is not tactical. It's called Bless Your Money. I woke up later than usual this morning. None of that 5 a.m. club stuff. My recent workouts have been harder, so I needed more rest. But allow me to get to the point. A few years back, in a dusty ancient bookshop in central London, I found a book called Bring Out the Magic in Your Mind. It was written many years ago by a man named Al Coran, who was then known as the finest mental magician in the world. In a chapter called The Secret of Wealth, he writes the following. When you send your money out, remember always to bless it. Ask it to bless everyone that it touches and command it to go out to feed the hungry and clothe the naked and command it to come back to you one million fold. Don't pass over this light. Just one of the ideas in this book is gonna disrupt the way you see success. You need to read it. Go to thewealthmoneycantbuy.com. Get your book now. And when you do, I'm gonna give you a three hour virtual summit, 10 morning mastering meditations, a complete online course for free as my gift to reward you for investing in your copy of The Wealth Money Can't Buy.
